description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Corpse Churn by paying {1}{B}, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Necromancy from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{B} and exiling three cards not used in the combo, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Necromancy to it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Necromancy
uses.cardState: attached to Scholar of the Ages
